name: cx-findings-to-fix
description: Findings-to-Fix brings two Checkmarx One AI agents into the developer's editor: AI Auto Triage decides which findings are real, and Remediation Assist generates the fix. The developer reviews each change and accepts it. Run /cx-findings-to-fix:fix in the project you want to fix: it pulls only the findings AI Auto Triage has confirmed on your branch, requests fixes from Remediation Assist, and proposes each as an edit you accept or reject.
